title: Thumb-thing's Cooking
notes: Held: only one independent source so far (Gold Derby, also syndicated on Yahoo and copied by bingchef.com) says Miles went home; an uncredited copy-site recap (bingchef/diningandcooking, original outlet unknown) agrees but doesn't count. Red won the 'Cell's Kitchen' challenge and Kylie cut her thumb but kept cooking. Instead of a scored team service, Ramsay put Mya, Kylie, Sandra, Gabe, Miles and Miguel in a cook-for-your-life test (listed as nominated), and Miles was sent home over his flank steak. Gold Derby describes Mike's move from Blue to Red at the start of this episode; it is already recorded in ep 7, so switched is left empty here. Rechecked Nov 14: still no second independent recap found (Moviedelic, Soap Central, Primetimer, TV Insider, Reality Blurred searched or unreachable; fan wiki unreachable). Needs a second source before posting.
